sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- CSC Hon'ble Surya Prakash Kesarwani,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Sri Parvesh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Nimai Das, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

Against the impugned order dated 07.04.2022 u/s 26 (2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, passed by the respondent no. 3, the petitioner has remedy of appeal u/s 76 of the Act, 2006.

In view of the aforesaid and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case of the petitioner, this writ petition is dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy, leaving it open for the petitioner to file an appeal before the appellate authority, if so advised.
